Video pengumuman fitur baru. Fitur yang dirilis: 

Cari keluarga: missing-person cards that travel between groups (0.34.0)
A card asking "have you seen this person?" reaches every phone in the
group and late joiners, crosses bridges, goes out over LoRa as a short
line, and is saved on each phone that sees it (7 days, at most 30) so it
is handed to every group that phone joins next. Anyone can mark the
person found; the update replaces the card everywhere. 

Mode lansia: big-button home for older family members (0.33.0)
An opt-in page over the full screen with three large buttons (SOS,
Saya aman, hold to talk), the family list with each person's status, the
latest announcement, and a red line when someone is in SOS. Off by
default; turned on from the profile sheet and off with "Mode lengkap".
Not connected yet, it offers Connect, which shows the normal screen until
a group is joined. A held talk button is not rebuilt by incoming updates.
iOS gets the same page and a toggle in the profile sheet.
